question: What is the main purpose of a Health Management Information System in a healthcare facility?

options.A: To schedule doctors and nurses for shift duties
options.B: To manage the financial salaries of hospital staff
options.C: To order medical supplies from international vendors
options.D: To collect, compile, analyze, and use health data

explanation: An HMIS is built specifically to handle health information rather than general administrative tasks like payroll or scheduling. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h1)

question: How do daily patient records written by a midwife in a rural clinic impact the wider health system?

options.A: They help shape national health policies and resource distribution
options.B: They are only used by the local facility to punish lazy workers
options.C: They replace the need for physical patient case notes entirely
options.D: They determine the personal tax deductions for healthcare workers

explanation: Individual data entries roll up into district and national reports, guiding where the government sends vaccines and funds. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h1)

question: What does data completeness mean when filling out maternity registers?

options.A: Every nurse has signed the attendance register daily
options.B: The computer system has finished backing up files
options.C: All patients in the community have visited the clinic
options.D: All required fields in the register are properly filled

explanation: Completeness requires that no mandatory information is left blank when documenting patient care. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h2)

question: Why is data consistency crucial across different health facilities in the country?

options.A: It ensures everyone uses the same clinical definitions for conditions
options.B: It stops patients from transferring between different hospitals
options.C: It guarantees that every clinic receives the exact same amount of cash
options.D: It removes the need for physical paper records in wards

explanation: Consistency means terms like maternal death or live birth are measured identically everywhere, making comparisons valid. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h2)

question: Which of these is a primary data source in a maternity ward?
explanation: Registers where patient encounters are first recorded serve as the fundamental source documents for HMIS. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h3)

question: What role does DHIS2 play in modern Nigerian health facilities?

options.A: It provides emergency ambulance dispatch services
options.B: It serves as a software platform for reporting health data
options.C: It acts as a physical vaccine storage refrigerator
options.D: It monitors the blood pressure of pregnant women automatically

explanation: DHIS2 is widely used across Nigeria as an electronic tool to manage, analyze, and report health management information. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h3)

question: Which indicator is commonly tracked in maternal and child health programs through HMIS?

options.C: Total number of surgical ward beds

explanation: Tracking how many women deliver under the care of skilled professionals is a core focus of maternal health information systems. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h4)

question: A maternity clinic notices a sharp rise in newborn infections in their monthly HMIS summary. What is the best action to take?

options.A: Ignore the data because monthly summaries are usually filled with errors
options.B: Stop recording newborn infections to lower the facility incidence rate
options.C: Investigate infection control practices in the labor ward immediately
options.D: Wait until the end of the year before looking at the infection numbers

explanation: HMIS data is meant to trigger action; a spike in infections requires an immediate review of clinical hygiene and cord care. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h4)

question: Where does health facility data usually go first after leaving a primary healthcare center?

options.A: To the World Health Organization headquarters
options.B: To the nearest tertiary teaching hospital
options.C: To the Local Government Area M&E officer
options.D: Directly to the Federal Minister of Health

explanation: The reporting chain starts by moving from individual primary health facilities to the LGA health department for collation. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h5)

question: What is the main reason health data is combined as it moves from local facilities up to the federal level?

options.A: To hide the names of individual patients from local government workers
options.B: To reduce the physical weight of paper documents being transported
options.C: To create summary reports that give a national overview of health trends
options.D: To ensure that rural clinics stop keeping their own local records

explanation: Aggregation combines thousands of individual entries into manageable statistics that show broad public health patterns across the country. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h5)

question: Which of the following is NOT a common challenge faced by health workers in routine HMIS data collection?

options.A: Irregular electricity supply affecting electronic record devices
options.B: Excessive availability of high-speed internet in rural clinics
options.C: Heavy paperwork burden that takes time away from patient care
options.D: Shortages of dedicated records personnel in primary facilities

explanation: Rural primary health centers in Nigeria typically suffer from poor or absent internet connectivity rather than an excess of it. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h6)

question: How can facilities best address poor data quality caused by rushed documentation?

options.A: Punish midwives by withholding their salaries when mistakes happen
options.B: Stop submitting monthly reports until the government builds new offices
options.C: Abolish all registers and rely entirely on patient memory for history
options.D: Conduct routine data quality audits and train staff on proper record keeping

explanation: Supportive supervision, regular audits, and continuous training improve accuracy much more effectively than punitive measures. [learn more](BMP123_U5_T1#BMP123_U5_T1_h6)
